scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistessingi Tengbang - Assistance To The Cultural Group For Training With New Production
other_conditions: Registered groups must have made at least 15 productions in the last 25 years (Category A) or meet the production thresholds for 3‑25 years (Category B)
Groups must have performed in at least 3–4 national or state level festivals/programmes
Applicant groups must not be receiving assistance from any other source for the same purpose
For Visual Art, Research & Book Publication, and Instrument/Costume Making, individual artists/artisans with adequate knowledge are eligible
Research & Book Publication must focus on Manipuri culture or translation of relevant works into Manipuri
benefits_summary: Financial assistance is provided via Direct Benefit Transfer to eligible cultural groups and individual artists for training, new productions, research, and related activities.
